description: This file provides utility functions for encryption and decryption using Blowfish and Base64 encoding. It includes functions for encoding, decoding, retrieving symmetric keys, and handling encryption with Blowfish, along with some project-specific security functions.

classes.name: Crypt_Blowfish
classes.description: A class from the Pear Crypt_Blowfish package used for Blowfish encryption and decryption.

methods.name: sugarEncode
methods.description: Base64-encodes the provided data. (Note: the key parameter is unused in this implementation)

methods.name: sugarDecode
methods.description: Decodes Base64-encoded data. (Note: the key parameter is unused in this implementation)

methods.name: blowfishGetKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a system-specific Blowfish key based on the provided type, storing it in a cache file.

methods.name: blowfishEncode
methods.description: Encrypts data using Blowfish and encodes it in Base64, storing the IV within the encoded data.

methods.name: blowfishDecode
methods.description: Decodes Base64-encoded Blowfish encrypted data and decrypts it, assuming the IV is embedded in the data.
